title: What's behind today's Wall Street showdowns: KKR vs TPG, Coinbase vsTrade Desk, and four BDC fights. Which are you watching?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:

TPG, JPMorgan faces McDonald's, and four BDC matchups built for income  
hunters hit the board. Plus Coinbase vs Trade Desk and two blockchain  
ETFs for the crypto crowd. No spoilers on the winners. Today's Wall  
Street matchups are below — which one are you taking?
